name: Lawyer advertising rules by state (50 states and DC)
description: The lawyer advertising rules of every US state and DC, in plain English: ad filing, what each ad must include, waiting periods for injury contact, claims and testimonials, referral and lead rules, ads in other languages, call-recording consent, texting law and privacy law, plus state laws on drug and medical-device ads. Each cell cites its official source with the words quoted, and is marked P: read at the official source.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Lawyer advertising rules by state (50 states and DC) (Version 1.5.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23958753

distribution.name: rules.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: rules.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: rules-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in rules-values.csv, one row per state, topic, column and value; join it to rules.csv on state and topic.

recordSet.name: rules
recordSet.description: The records of Lawyer advertising rules by state (50 states and DC), one per CSV row.

field.name: state
field.description: Two-letter code (DC for the District of Columbia)

field.name: topic
field.description: Rule topic key: filing, requiredContent, waitingPeriod, claims, referral, language, recording, texting, privacy

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day the state was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: humanUrl
field.description: The state page anchor to cite for this cell

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: sourcesAccessed
field.description: The day each source was read, in the same order

field.name: sourceQuotes
field.description: v1.3: the words quoted from each source, in the same order (P cells quote every source)

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
